summary: Peak week — first sweet-spot cycling stimulus, posterior chain strength, two easy aerobic spins. Highest quality load of the block.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic base maintenance — mitochondrial density and fat oxidation at low metabolic cost

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, cadence 80-85 rpm, legs loosening — no pressure
Z2 steady aerobic — 146-155 bpm, cadence 85-90 rpm. If HR exceeds 158 bpm, reduce watts.
Z1 easy wind-down, let HR drop under 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot 2×8min
sessions.focus: Sweet-spot training at 88-93% FTP — raises lactate threshold and aerobic capacity simultaneously; highest quality stimulus per minute available at this training age

steps.description: Progressive spin: 2 min Z1 (under 106W), then 3 min building to Z2 top-end 130-140W. Cadence 85-90 rpm.
Sweet-spot effort — 88-93% FTP, Z3 upper/Z4 lower, target HR 163-175 bpm. Cadence 88-92 rpm. Controlled discomfort — short sentences still possible.
Easy spin recovery — let HR drop to 145 bpm or below before starting next rep. Z1.
Z1 progressive wind-down, cadence free, HR back under 130 bpm

sessions.name: Posterior Chain & Anti-Rotation Core
sessions.focus: Posterior chain loading (glutes, hamstrings, single-leg stability) and anti-extension/anti-rotation core — addresses quad dominance contributing to anterior knee pain; no spinal flexion under load, no deep knee flexion
sessions.notes: 3 rounds: 10x Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift per leg (11kg), 10x TRX Split Squat per leg (bodyweight, high rear foot — stop before any knee pain), 15x Dumbbell Glute Bridge (16kg on hips, 2-sec hold at top), 20m Farmer Carry (11kg each hand), 8x Dead Bug per side (bodyweight). 60s rest between rounds. No goblet squats. Stop any exercise immediately if anterior knee pain appears.

steps.description: Bodyweight glute bridges 15 reps, leg swings front-to-back 10 each leg, lateral band walks 15 steps each direction, hip circles 10 each direction. Activates glutes and primes hip stability before loading.

3 rounds of circuit: 10x Single-Leg RDL/leg (11kg) → 10x TRX Split Squat/leg (BW, high rear foot) → 15x Dumbbell Glute Bridge (16kg) → 20m Farmer Carry (11kg each) → 8x Dead Bug/side (BW). 60s rest between rounds.
Static stretching: hip flexor stretch 60s/side, figure-four glute stretch 60s/side, standing hamstring stretch 45s/side, child's pose 45s. No aggressive forward spinal flexion.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin — Week Closer
sessions.focus: Active recovery and aerobic consolidation — promotes recovery from Wednesday's quality session, sustains weekly aerobic volume, reinforces fat-oxidation without adding fatigue ahead of recovery week

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 80-85 rpm — no effort, just waking the legs
Z2 easy aerobic — 146-155 bpm, cadence 85-90 rpm. Lower end of Z2 today — this is recovery-promoting, not a push. If feeling flat, drop to 100-110W.
Z1 wind-down, HR under 125 bpm before stopping

summary: Recovery week — volume drops ~40%, all sessions easy, let supercompensation land. No quality sessions. This is where the adaptation from the peak week actually occurs.

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery — Z1/Z2 only, blood flow, no metabolic stress

sessions.name: Maintenance Strength — Light
sessions.focus: Movement quality and posterior chain maintenance at reduced load — preserve adaptation without adding fatigue

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Low-intensity aerobic maintenance, Z2 ceiling, full recovery mode

summary: New base block begins — rebuild aerobic volume with extended Z2 cycling, reintroduce running if knees are symptom-free, and progress strength loading. Polarised: 80% easy.

sessions.name: Z2 Aerobic Build
sessions.focus: Extended aerobic base — mitochondrial density, fat oxidation, foundation for next build phase

sessions.name: Easy Run — Z2 (Knee check)
sessions.focus: Reintroduce running stimulus — Z2 aerobic, assess knee response, short duration

sessions.name: Posterior Chain & Core — Progressive Load
sessions.focus: Progressed posterior chain strength — increase single-leg RDL load, add hip thrust variation

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic volume consolidation — Z2, easy, closes the base week

summary: Build block — introduce tempo cycling intervals (Z3), extend easy run to 35+ min if knees allow, progress strength to heavier posterior chain loads. One quality session per week, 80/20 distribution.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic base maintenance — Z2, low fatigue cost ahead of quality session

sessions.name: Tempo Intervals 3×10min
sessions.focus: Lactate threshold development — sustained Z3 tempo effort raises FTP ceiling

sessions.name: Full Posterior Chain — Progressive Overload
sessions.focus: Strength progression — heavier single-leg RDL, TRX Nordic curl introduction, anti-rotation core progression

sessions.name: Easy Run — Z2 Extended
sessions.focus: Running aerobic base — Z2 easy, extend duration, build running-specific adaptation
